meta.title: Shoulder Injury & Rotator Cuff Rehabilitation | Cambridge Hospital
meta.description: Relieving pain and restoring shoulder mobility through targeted therapy.

overview: Shoulder injuries, including rotator cuff tears, impingement and post-surgical recovery can significantly restrict upper limb function and daily activities.

At Cambridge Hospital, our shoulder rehabilitation programme combines manual therapy, targeted strengthening, range-of-motion exercises, and functional retraining to restore full shoulder function. Both conservative management and post-operative rehabilitation are available through our outpatient physiotherapy clinics.
